name: How Does Kitchen Cabinet Replacement Happen?

step.name: Step 1: Initial Consultation and Design – This is where we chat about your vision! We'll visit your Las Vegas home, discuss your style preferences, functional needs, and budget. We'll take measurements, offer ideas on different cabinet styles (like shaker, flat-panel, or raised-panel), materials (wood, laminate), and finishes, and start sketching out a preliminary design. This phase usually takes a few days to get all the details just right.
step.text: Step 1: Initial Consultation and Design – This is where we chat about your vision! We'll visit your Las Vegas home, discuss your style preferences, functional needs, and budget. We'll take measurements, offer ideas on different cabinet styles (like shaker, flat-panel, or raised-panel), materials (wood, laminate), and finishes, and start sketching out a preliminary design. This phase usually takes a few days to get all the details just right.

step.name: Step 2: Material Selection and Ordering – Once the design is finalized, you'll choose your specific cabinet materials, colors, and hardware. We'll help you pick options that fit your aesthetic and practical needs. After your selections are confirmed, we place the order. Cabinet fabrication times can vary, but typically this step involves a waiting period of several weeks for custom or semi-custom units to be manufactured and delivered.

step.name: Step 3: Demolition and Preparation – Before new cabinets can go in, the old ones have to come out! Our team carefully removes your existing cabinets, ensuring minimal disruption to your home. We also prepare the walls, checking for any necessary repairs, patching, or painting that should happen before installation. This demolition phase usually takes 1-2 days, depending on the kitchen size.

step.name: Step 4: New Cabinet Installation – This is where your new kitchen starts to take shape! Our skilled installers meticulously fit and secure your new cabinets, ensuring they are level, plumb, and perfectly aligned. This includes installing the base cabinets, then the upper cabinets, and any pantry or specialty units. This precise work often takes 3-5 days, as attention to detail is key for a beautiful and functional result.

step.name: Step 5: Finishing Touches and Cleanup – After the main cabinet installation, we install any necessary trim, molding, and hardware (like handles and knobs). We’ll also do a thorough cleanup of the work area, leaving your kitchen ready for the next steps, like countertop installation. This final step usually wraps up in 1-2 days. Throughout the entire process, Simply Construction coordinates everything, making sure your kitchen transformation is smooth and stress-free. We're committed to delivering a beautiful, functional kitchen that you'll love for years to come in your Las Vegas home.
